subject.title: improve(agents): exact web_fetch output contract with cleaned result shape

question: Should OpenClaw accept removal of the retired model-facing `web_fetch` fields in favor of the new closed `length`/`spill` contract after live proof, or preserve an explicitly documented compatibility path?
rationale: The repository policy favors removing stale model-facing fields rather than hiding compatibility, but accepting a changed tool-result contract is a maintainer product and upgrade-boundary choice that tests alone cannot settle.

options.title: Accept the clean contract after proof
options.body: Keep the closed schema and retired fields removed once a redacted real run demonstrates the supported direct, provider, cache, and spill outputs.

options.title: Require a compatibility plan
options.body: Preserve or formally deprecate the old result fields only if maintainers identify a supported consumer contract that cannot migrate to the new shape now.

recommendation.title: Accept the clean contract after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the closed schema and retired fields removed once a redacted real run demonstrates the supported direct, provider, cache, and spill outputs.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the proposed contract and its affected integration boundaries; confidence is limited because current-main feature history could not be established from the supplied material.
